نَاهِدٌ A girl's breast that is swelling, prominent, or protuberant: pl. نَوَاهِدُ; which denotes more than فَوَالِكُ. (A 'Obeyd, L.) ―
-b2- Also, and ↓ نَاهِدَةٌ (S, L, Msb, K) and ↓ مُنَهِّدٌ , (L, K,) or مُنَهِّدَةٌ, (as in the TA,) A girl, or woman, having swelling, prominent, or protuberant, breasts: (S, L, Msb, K:) or a woman whose breasts have become full: (Munjid of Kr:) pl. نَوَاهِدُ. (Msb.) ―
-b3- نَاهِدٌ A boy nearly come to the age of puberty. (A.) ―
-b4- نَاهِدٌ Attacking or assaulting, or rising and hastening and going forth to or towards an enemy: pl. نُهَّادٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b5- See نَهْدٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
